name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR first. This exposes how it handles edge cases and stale data without risking live reviews. The trade-off is slower feedback on newer issues, but we prioritize stability and learning from past mistakes.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the oldest merged PR risks testing a stale routing/prompt stack that may no longer reflect current logic—wasting time on irrelevant edge cases. Better: run shadow mode on the *newest open PR* first, since it tests the latest routing/prompt changes where bugs are most likely to surface. Settle by checking if the newest PR’s routing/prompt is the one actively being iterated on.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on both the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR in parallel to compare results—this cuts total testing time by half while still validating edge cases and fresh logic. If the outputs diverge, prioritize fixing the newest PR’s routing first since it carries higher risk of propagating errors.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It tests the latest routing/prompt changes where fresh bugs are most likely to hide, giving us faster feedback to fix real issues now. The trade-off is we skip testing the oldest merged PR’s edge cases first, but stability matters more when we’re still shaping the prompt stack. If shadow mode flags nothing, we’ll still run the oldest PR next to confirm no stale logic lingers.

name: Ratchet
text: DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first, then the oldest merged PR if outputs look clean—this tests freshest logic first while still catching stale edge cases later. Result: validated routing/prompts with no live risk, owned by Overhaul.
